items.name: Befrena launch ramp (U.S. clinics)
items.claim: Elanco reported Befrena had shipped to nearly 1,400 U.S. clinics, with customer demand 2x above expectations and capacity being ramped weekly.
items.source_excerpt: Befrena™ shipped to nearly 1,400 U.S. clinics to date; ramping capacity to meet high customer demand 2x above expectations, with weekly increases in supply

items.name: Zenrelia and Credelio Quattro innovation launches
items.claim: Elanco named Zenrelia, its newest blockbuster, as the single largest contributor to company growth in the quarter, followed by Credelio Quattro.
items.source_excerpt: Zenrelia — our newest blockbuster — was the single largest contributor to global Elanco growth, closely followed by Credelio Quattro.
